title: Transfers

help.title: About transfers
help.overview: A transfer moves a car to another location. The car is blocked for bookings while it is on the way, and is counted at its new location once it arrives.

sections.title: On this page
items: The leave and arrive times can't be changed later; cancel the transfer and plan a new one instead.
The fleet planner shows planned transfers and bookings that need a car from another location.
